title: Sevagrad Fortification — Who Builds It?
location: Ministry of Defense — Strategic Planning Room

narrative.text: The Sevagrad border fortifications will be forty kilometers of reinforced positions, observation posts, and defensive infrastructure. This is military construction — it requires military-grade specifications and security clearances. The contractor question has security dimensions.

The State Bureau has built military installations before. They are slow but they understand the security requirements. Vael's group has never done military construction — I have concerns about their security protocols. The foreign consortium is impossible — no foreign company can build our border defenses. But they have offered to provide engineering consultation instead.

choices.text: "State Bureau. Military construction requires military discipline. They will do it right — slowly, but right."
"Vael Construction. They will need security oversight but they will deliver on schedule. The military will supervise the classified aspects. Vael handles the concrete and steel."
"State Bureau builds it. The foreign consortium provides engineering consultation — but no access to classified specifications. Best of both worlds."
